prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-detailed photorealistic high-fashion evening-gown portrait in a light-gray studio.
prompt.main_subject: An adult fictional woman with original features, elegant low-bun updo, natural realistic skin, and a calm confident expression. She wears a deep-white lace and sequin evening gown with a dramatic V neckline and refined fitted silhouette.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered upper-body portrait, intricate lace and sequin detail across the gown, soft-gray background with a defined cast shadow, strong face and fabric hierarchy.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft studio lighting with dramatic shadowplay, controlled highlights on sequins and lace, polished editorial atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Hyperrealistic 8K-style fashion photography, sharp facial and textile detail, natural proportions, clean light-gray studio, no logos or text.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-detailed photorealistic portrait of an adult fictional woman with original features, elegant low-bun updo, natural realistic skin, and a calm confident expression, wearing a deep-white lace and sequin evening gown with a dramatic V neckline and refined fitted silhouette. High-fashion editorial, soft studio lighting, light-gray background, dramatic shadowplay, hyperrealistic 8K-style detail, sharp face and fabric texture.
prompt.negative_prompt: celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, blurry, low quality, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, deformed, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, logo, text, signature
